+import threading
+
+from bank import ledger
+from bank.money import Money
+
+THREADS = 20
+
+
+def test_BENCH18_twenty_threads_one_guarded_withdrawal_succeeds(tmp_path, run_together):
+    assert hasattr(ledger, "withdraw_guarded"), "ledger.withdraw_guarded is missing"
+    path = tmp_path / "guarded.db"
+    setup = ledger.open_db(path)
+    account = ledger.open_account(setup, ledger.create_customer(setup, "Guarded Customer"), "EUR")
+    ledger.deposit(setup, account.id, Money.of("100.00", "EUR"))
+    results: list[str] = []
+    lock = threading.Lock()
+
+    def worker(start):
+        conn = ledger.open_db(path)
+        try:
+            start()
+            try:
+                ledger.withdraw_guarded(conn, account.id, Money.of("80.00", "EUR"))
+                outcome = "ok"
+            except ledger.InsufficientFunds:
+                outcome = "refused"
+        finally:
+            conn.close()
+        with lock:
+            results.append(outcome)
+
+    assert run_together(THREADS, worker) == []
+    assert results.count("ok") == 1, results
+    assert ledger.get_account(setup, account.id).balance_minor == 2000
+    assert ledger.check_invariants(setup) == []
